solver_adapter.name: real_openfoam_common_pressure_reference_verified
solver_adapter.strategy_description: Use one common nostril static pressure and fixed outlet static pressure; an outer loop adjusts the common inlet pressure to match the total-flow target. Do not impose a flow boundary simultaneously.

diagnostic_basis.mass_imbalance_fraction: Take the steady-segment value (final-samples window) of mass_imbalance_fraction for the engineering screen comparison. The startup transient (initial non-divergence-free field, e.g. the global max 6.3324e-03 at t=2 in T-006 Run 1) is reported separately and excluded from the screen. Rationale: an initial field that is not divergence-free produces a startup artifact, not a solver defect; this never relaxes the maximum_mass_imbalance_fraction screen of 0.005.
diagnostic_basis.monitor_relative_change: monitor_relative_change is the inter-window relative change of dP, where dP = area-weighted mean nostril static pressure minus nasopharynx outlet static pressure. Compute over the last 40% of monitor samples with a window length of 20 consecutive samples; take the window-mean of each window, then the maximum of the successive window-mean ratios. T-006 Run 1 measured 0.0079%.

notes: No patient flow solution is included.
Equal bilateral flow is an imposed comparison only, never a measured patient split.
Fixed flow plus one static pressure reference is valid; fixed flow plus a prescribed two-end pressure difference is not this contract.
Frozen b15 engineering example, not p0/p3 or an uploaded case.
Existing mesh has Failed 2 mesh checks; surface optimisation cap deviations and six-cell gap resolution are not accuracy-certified.
This uses the user-approved M1/M2 engineering trial branch. Clinical validation remains absent.
T-029: same b15 geometry/mesh/physical and quality settings; only U convection changed to upwind.
120-step budget and 20-step field writes are run controls. No automatic extension to 300.
10 Pa common nostril static pressure is the first outer evaluation; no fixed flow split is imposed.

numerical_trial.meaning: bounded engineering stability trial; not convergence or accuracy validation

case_manifest.json.note: truthful manifest; source is patient msh, NOT tube.stl; diagnostic override therefore cannot apply per run_openfoam_case.py:469-472
case_manifest.json.engineering_input_provenance: T-029 numerical version of frozen b15_engineering; only input folders copied; old results excluded
